about_the_game:
💎 MEET MISS STORM!

Raise the sails—Miss Storm is on the horizon! She's not just a pirate in a skirt, she's a full-blown hurricane of lust and adrenaline. Every step is bold, every glance defiant, every word sharp as her blade, and that body... It was made to conquer anyone who dares cross her path. On her hip swings more than just a sword—there's also a shiny collection of cuffs, "for those especially wild nights."

Miss Storm doesn't tolerate boredom. She lives for danger, stolen treasure and wild, breathtaking sex. One night she'll shove a bottle of rum in your mouth—the next, she'll toss you a whip and growl: "Come on. Entertain your captain!" Her favorite games—blindfolds, ropes and orders that'll make your knees buckle. Miss Storm is unpredictable, untamable and blazing hot!

📜 WHAT ELSE DO YOU GET?

By purchasing this DLC, you'll unlock Miss Storm as your mascot! You can switch mascots anytime by opening the "Mascot" tab on the home screen.

You'll also receive 10,000 Gold, 100 Rubies and 10 Common Mystic Tomes.

But most importantly—you'll have our heartfelt thanks. Thank you for choosing to support this DLC!

content_descriptors.notes:
All characters in the game are over 20 years old.
This DLC contains explicit adult themes, including nudity and sexual acts. Please be aware and ensure that you are in an appropriate location before playing to avoid causing distress to others.
